# Keygen refinement proof: notes

Keygen proves its own tree build (no dependency on Sign/TreeBuild*; keygen's instance has no
capture code).

* `XSim.lean`: exact-cost refinement relation (`XSim image s k c n b oa Q`: exactly `k` steps,
  `c` cycles, `n` calls, `b` compressions for every oracle), combinators (`pure_steps`, `bind`,
  `steps`, `query`, `hash16(_bind)`, `foldlM_range(')` with per-iteration costs, `run_eq`).
  Exact-cost variant of `Sign/Sim.lean`'s `Sim` (which bounds cycles).
* `Blocks.lean` (generated by `gen_keygen.py`): segment table and `sym_block`s of all straight-line
  pieces of the keygen image.
* Memory is reasoned about at doubleword level (`getMem` of 8-aligned keys) and hash inputs via
  `Result.hashInput_toState` / `queryOfWords`.
* Shared byte lemmas live in `Expand/Mem.lean`.
